hr.metaTitle: FESB Racing — Od ploče do staze
hr.metaDesc: Studentski inženjerski tim FESB-a iz Splita. Projektiramo, gradimo i utrkujemo Formula Student bolide i MotoStudent motocikle.
hr.joinTitle: Tu se ne spava prije natjecanja.
hr.joinText: Tražimo studente strojarstva, elektrotehnike, računarstva i ekonomije koji žele graditi, a ne samo učiti.

teams.name: Mehanika
teams.d: Šasija, ovjes, pogonski sklop i kočnice. Od CAD modela do zavarenog okvira.

teams.name: Elektronika & Software
teams.d: Vlastite tiskane pločice, VCU algoritam upravljanja vozilom, senzorika i telemetrija.

teams.name: Aerodinamika
teams.d: CFD simulacije, krila i difuzor — svaki Newton potisne sile uz što manje otpora.

teams.name: Aerodinamika & Karoserija
teams.d: Kompozitna karoserija, kalupi i laminacija karbonskih vlakana.

teams.name: Marketing & Biznis
teams.d: Partnerstva, brend, mediji i poslovni plan koji branimo pred sucima na natjecanjima.

vehicles.name: Formula Student bolid
vehicles.d: Jednosjed razvijen za statičke i dinamičke discipline: acceleration, skidpad, autocross i endurance.

vehicles.name: MotoStudent motocikl
vehicles.d: Utrkački prototip motocikla razvijen od okvira do elektronike za natjecanje MotoStudent u Španjolskoj.

comps.name: Formula Student Italy
comps.sub: Autodromo Riccardo Paletti, Varano de' Melegari

comps.name: Rimac FS Alpe Adria

hr.sponText: Vaša tehnologija na stazi, vaš brend pred europskim inženjerskim talentima. Nudimo vidljivost, zapošljavanje i suradnju na stvarnom razvoju.
hr.fSent: Prijava zaprimljena. Javljamo se prije sljedećeg okupljanja u radionici.
hr.fSentCompany: Hvala! Upit je zaprimljen, javit ćemo vam se u nekoliko radnih dana.
hr.companyText: Tražite mlade inženjere, vidljivost na europskim stazama ili partnera za razvoj? Pošaljite nam par riječi o sebi i javit ćemo se sa sponzorskim paketom.
hr.heroSub: Studentski inženjerski tim FESB-a. Projektiramo, gradimo i utrkujemo Formula Student bolide i MotoStudent motocikle.

chapters.d: Skupina studenata odlučila je da teorijski proračuni s ploče ne smiju ostati samo na papiru. Htjeli su zvuk motora, miris spaljenih guma i inovaciju u vlastitim rukama.
Tu se ne spava prije natjecanja. Do sitnih sati projektiraju se šasije, razvijaju vlastite PCB pločice, piše VCU algoritam, optimizira aerodinamika i testira svaki milimetar ovjesa.
Udruga specijaliziranih timova koja razvija Formula Student bolide i MotoStudent utrkačke motocikle.

hr.mission: Most između akademske teorije i vrhunskog inženjerstva u stvarnom svijetu.

en.metaTitle: FESB Racing — From whiteboard to track
en.metaDesc: The student engineering team of FESB in Split. We design, build and race Formula Student cars and MotoStudent motorcycles.
en.joinText: We are looking for mechanical, electrical, computing and economics students who want to build, not just study.

teams.name: Mechanics
teams.d: Chassis, suspension, powertrain and brakes. From CAD model to welded frame.

teams.name: Electronics & Software
teams.d: In-house PCBs, the VCU vehicle control algorithm, sensors and telemetry.

teams.name: Aerodynamics
teams.d: CFD simulation, wings and diffuser — every newton of downforce at minimum drag.

teams.name: Aerodynamics & Bodywork
teams.d: Composite bodywork, moulds and carbon fibre lamination.

teams.name: Marketing & Business
teams.d: Partnerships, brand, media and the business plan we defend in front of judges.

vehicles.name: Formula Student car
vehicles.d: A single-seater built for static and dynamic events: acceleration, skidpad, autocross and endurance.
vehicles.img: The eFRT01 car at a competition

vehicles.name: MotoStudent motorcycle
vehicles.d: A race motorcycle prototype developed from frame to electronics for MotoStudent in Spain.

en.sponText: Your technology on track, your brand in front of Europe’s engineering talent. We offer visibility, recruiting and collaboration on real development.

en.companyText: Looking for young engineers, visibility on European tracks or a development partner? Tell us a little about your company and we will get back to you with our sponsorship pack.
en.heroSub: The student engineering team of FESB. We design, build and race Formula Student cars and MotoStudent motorcycles.

chapters.d: A group of students decided that calculations on the whiteboard must not stay on paper. They wanted engine sound, the smell of burnt rubber and innovation in their own hands.
Nobody sleeps before a competition. Late into the night we design chassis, develop our own PCBs, write the VCU control algorithm, optimise aero and test every millimetre of suspension.
An association of specialised teams developing Formula Student cars and MotoStudent race motorcycles.

en.mission: A bridge between academic theory and top-level real-world engineering.
